children: is bringing its luxury resale model to Boston with its first brick-and-mortar store in Massachusetts.
The new 1,800 square foot store opened on the tony Boylston Street, Chestnut Hill neighborhood, tapping into the strength of its existing community of buyers and consignors across Greater Boston.

“The intersection of some of the region’s most affluent and engaged communities, together with its growing mix of fashion, luxury, and lifestyle brands, made it a natural home for the RealReal’s first Massachusetts location,” the company said in a
Besides the affluent customers, the RealReal’s

new location aims to capitalize on the growing demand for consignment and resale. According to an internal company report, demand for vintage has quadrupled since 2020, led by the increased fluidity between new and resale among Gen Z and Millennial shoppers, who view pre-owned luxury as “part of the same fashion ecosystem.”
